时笙满脸纠结的看着前方的两人，你丫的到底上是不上啊？说那么多废话搞毛线！！

这种现场版的大片，本宝宝好不容易能看一次，别耽搁时间，赶紧上啊！

大片最终还是上演了，龙玦从一开始愤怒的低吼，到最后变成原始的闷哼，叶清秋做这些明显很熟练，高难度的动作一个接着一个。

看着时笙一个劲的咋舌，这可比某岛国大片还好看，可惜就是男的动作太少了。

等两人精疲力尽的结束，叶清秋给龙玦喂了什么东西，然后不顾龙玦羞愤的低吼，将他给带走了。

这下有好戏看了，啧啧！

时笙意犹未尽的回去找凤辞，凤辞就站在宫殿的台阶上，看到时笙，脚下极快的走了几步，又猛的顿住，遥遥的看向朝着他走过来的人影，心中忐忑。

“阿辞，我累了。”时笙走近凤辞，软软的往他怀里靠，昨晚折腾了那么久，今天她又走了那么远，确实有些累。

凤辞手脚都不知道怎么放，小心翼翼的看了时笙几眼，见她神色没有异样，这才将她抱起来往殿里走。

“阿辞，叶清秋住什么地方？”时笙小脸贴着他的脖子，说话的时候，热气直往他脖子上扑，酥酥痒痒的，挠得他整个人都有些飘飘然。

他稳了稳心境，深呼吸一口气道：“新晋的小仙都要拜见仙帝，然后由仙帝赐仙宫府邸，她应该还没见过仙帝，可能被安排在了陆章那里。”

“陆章？”

“嗯。”凤辞歪了歪头，思索了片刻，“仙界的大总管。”

噗——

仙界大总管是什么梗？

凤辞将时笙放到床上，欺身就压了上来，目光灼灼的俯视着她，“小殊，你不能离开我。”

“好。”时笙笑了笑，“你下来，压得我不舒服。”

凤辞认真的盯着她，似乎在辨别她说的真假，最后在她唇角亲了亲，翻身睡到旁边，“睡吧，醒了带你去仙界走走。”

时笙愣了下，伸手抱住他的腰，换了个舒服的位置睡下。

最近仙界有两件大事，第一件事是消失近千年的凤辞回来了，而且还是带着下界一个飞升的女子一起回来，特别是那个女子有推算不出来的命格。

凤辞回来的第二天就抢了各大仙宫，还抓了不少仙君去给他修宫殿，修好之后就把人给扔了出来，之后就一直没在仙界出现。

据说凤辞很宠那个女子！

据说那个女子说的话，凤辞都会听……

最重要的是，那个女子能和凤辞亲密接触，完全不惧怕他身上的火焰。

Shi Sheng looked at the two people in front of him with a troubled face. Are you going to fuck me or not?Talking so much nonsense and making nonsense!!

It's hard for me to watch this kind of live blockbuster movie once, so don't waste time, hurry up and watch it!

The blockbuster was finally staged. Long Jue roared in anger at the beginning and turned into a primitive groan at the end. Ye Qingqiu was obviously very skilled in doing these, and he performed difficult moves one after another.

Seeing Shi Sheng speechless, this is even better than a blockbuster movie from an island country, but it's a pity that the male action is too little.

After the two of them were exhausted, Ye Qingqiu fed Long Jue something, and then took him away regardless of Long Jue's shy and angry growl.

Now there is something good to watch, tsk tsk!

Shi Sheng went back to look for Feng Ci. Feng Ci was standing on the steps of the palace. When he saw Shi Sheng, he took a few steps very quickly, then stopped suddenly and looked at the figure walking towards him from a distance, feeling uneasy in his heart.

"A Ci, I'm tired." Shi Sheng approached Feng Ci and leaned softly into his arms. She had been struggling for so long last night and had walked so far today, so she was indeed a little tired.

Feng Ci didn't know what to do with his hands and feet. He looked at Shi Sheng cautiously and saw that she didn't look strange, then he picked her up and walked into the palace.

"Aci, where does Ye Qingqiu live?" Shi Sheng's face was pressed against his neck. When he spoke, the hot air rushed to his neck, tickling him and making him feel a little dizzy.

He stabilized his mind, took a deep breath and said: "The newly promoted Immortal must pay homage to the Immortal Emperor, and then the Immortal Emperor will grant him a palace in the Immortal Palace. She probably hasn't met the Immortal Emperor yet, and may have been arranged to stay with Lu Zhang."

"Lu Zhang?"

"Yeah." Feng Ci tilted his head and thought for a moment, "The chief manager of the fairy world."

Poof——

What is the meaning of the Great Steward of the Immortal Realm?

Feng Ci put Shi Sheng on the bed and pressed her up, looking down at her with burning eyes, "Xiao Shu, you can't leave me."

"Okay." Shi Sheng smiled, "Come down, it will make me uncomfortable."

Feng Ci stared at her seriously, as if he was trying to discern whether what she said was true or false. Finally, he kissed the corner of her lips and turned over to sleep next to her. "Go to sleep. I'll take you to the fairy world when I wake up."

Shi Sheng was stunned for a moment, put his arms around his waist, and changed into a comfortable position to sleep.

There have been two major events in the fairy world recently. The first thing is that Feng Ci, who has disappeared for nearly a thousand years, has returned, and he has come back with an ascended woman from the lower realm, especially since that woman has a destiny that cannot be calculated.

The day after Feng Ci came back, he robbed all the major fairy palaces and captured many immortal kings to build palaces for him. After the repairs, they threw the people out, and he has not appeared in the fairy world since.

It is said that Feng Ci dotes on that woman very much!

It is said that Feng Ci will listen to whatever the woman says...

The most important thing is that the woman can have close contact with Feng Ci and is not afraid of the flames on his body at all.
